decisions.reason: After several years without renewed visibility, the indoor air quality sensor appears less clearly above aspiration than the more focused sensing modules, so we would reallocate its resources.
As the established next-generation replacement in a proven voltage-measurement line, it is likely still meeting aspiration relative to its predecessor and comparable modules.
The MQTT proxy strengthens the software side of the modular platform at low carrying cost, so without clear evidence of an aspiration shortfall we would keep it.
The carbon dioxide sensor module remains closely aligned with the firm's core sensing portfolio and likely performs acceptably against comparable products, so we keep it.

The touch panel accessory is relatively peripheral to the core platform and, after extended uncertainty, is the most plausible product to drop in order to free resources for stronger lines and new development.
